visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, short black hair, wearing a black t-shirt with a small square logo, stands in a brightly lit indoor space filled with glass display cases containing various mineral specimens. He holds a white, porous mineral rock in his left hand, gesturing towards it with his right hand as he speaks. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the same mineral rock being illuminated by a purple-tinted UV light, causing the rock's surface to glow with bright blue and white phosphorescence against a dark background. (3) The shot returns to the man in glasses, who continues his explanation while still holding the glowing mineral; his expression is calm and professional as he looks slightly off-camera. (4) The camera pans and cuts to a second man standing nearby, wearing a black t-shirt with a graphic of a bull and 'FORMOSA Mineral 2025' text; he is smiling broadly and laughing at a comment. (5) A close-up shows a different mineral, a dark, metallic, and jagged specimen held in two hands against a blurred background. (6) The second man holds this metallic mineral, points to it with his index finger while looking into the camera with a playful grin, and eventually gives a thumbs-up gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an off-screen male voice interviewing an expert about a mineral's safety, while a mid-tempo, funky electronic BGM with a strong bassline plays in the background. (2) A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the expert answers questions about phosphorescence and radiation in a calm, clear tone. (3) The interviewer makes a pun on 'phosphorus' and 'danger,' followed by a sharp 'ding' sound effect and the audible sound of the expert chuckling and saying 'Mhm.' (4) A second on-screen male voice is heard laughing heartily, which creates a high-arousal acoustic atmosphere. (5) The interviewer continues with a high-pitched, playful inquiry about the second person's happiness, accompanied by bubbly pop SFX. (6) The second man responds with a short, affirmative 'Okay' in a slightly strained but humorous tone. (7) The interviewer delivers the final pun 'Du Bian Zhi Mei,' followed by a celebratory comic-style sound effect as the music swells slightly towards the end.
